subject: general
question: Profit of Rs. 25 is made on an article costing Rs.125 What is the profit percentage?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit % = (Profit ÷ Cost Price) × 100

= (25 ÷ 125) × 100

= (1 ÷ 5) × 100

= 20%

**∴ Answer = 20%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = 125

Profit = 25

Selling Price (SP) = 125 + 25 = 150

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

 CP = 125 Profit = 25 SP = 150 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Profit % = (25 ÷ 125) × 100

⇒ = (1 ÷ 5) × 100

⇒ = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**
